chunks: Muʿāwiyah ibn ʿAmmār narrated from him, peace be upon him, that he said:
"When you purchase your hady, face it toward the qiblah and sacrifice it by nahr or slaughter it, and say:

"I have turned my face toward the One who originated the heavens and the earth, inclining upright, as a Muslim, and I am not among the polytheists. Indeed, my salat, my sacrifice, my life, and my death are for Allah, Lord of the worlds. He has no partner, and with that I have been commanded, and I am among the Muslims."
O Allah, from You and for You. In the Name of Allah, and Allah is the Greatest. O Allah, accept from me.
Then pass the knife over it, and do not sever its spinal cord until it dies."

key_terms.الْقِبْلَةَ: the direction faced during worship, toward which the animal is turned
key_terms.انْحَرْهُ: sacrifice it by piercing the upper chest, as done with certain animals
key_terms.تَقَبَّلْ: accept, meaning accept the act of worship
key_terms.نُسُكِي: my sacrificial rite and act of devotion
key_terms.هَدْيَكَ: your sacrificial animal offered in the rites of hajj

ai.seo_question: What should be said and done when slaughtering the hady in hajj according to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives the prescribed etiquette and wording for slaughtering the sacrificial animal in hajj. It combines legal instruction with tawhid-centered supplication, directing the sacrificer to face the animal toward the qiblah, invoke Allah, and avoid mutilation by not severing the spinal cord before death.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3084 - Muawiyah ibn Ammar narrated from Imam (as) that he said:
"When you purchase your hady (sacrificial animal), face it towards the Qiblah and slaughter or sacrifice it, and say:

'I have turned my face towards the One who created the heavens and the earth, inclining to the truth, as a submitter [to Allah (swt)], and I am not among the polytheists. Indeed, my prayer, my sacrifice, my life, and my death are for Allah (swt), the Lord (azj) of the worlds. He has no partner, and with this, I have been commanded, and I am among the submitters.
O Allah (swt), this is from You and for You. In name of Allah (swt), Allah (swt) is the Greatest. O Allah (swt), accept it from me.'
Then pass the knife over it, but do not sever its spinal cord until it dies."
